title: Illinois just told every operating system to start reporting your kid's age
summary: Illinois has passed legislation requiring operating systems to report and verify children's ages, imposing new compliance requirements on tech companies regarding minor users. The bill specifically targets OS-level age verification and reporting mechanisms, likely expanding upon federal COPPA regulations.
problem_solved: Addresses the need for better age verification and tracking of minors using digital devices and operating systems.
why_valuable: This legislation sets a precedent for OS-level age reporting requirements, potentially impacting how operating systems handle children's data and privacy across the entire technology industry.
